title: Implement one milestone
whenToUse: You already have a plan and want a single slice.
whenNotToUse: You ask for the entire product in one shot.
promptTemplate:
GOAL:
Implement ONLY milestone {{milestoneId}}: {{milestoneTitle}}.

CONTEXT:
Follow existing patterns in {{paths}}.

INPUT:
Acceptance: {{acceptance}}.

CONSTRAINTS:
- No unrelated refactors
- No new deps unless justified and verified
- Keep diff reviewable

OUTPUT:
Code changes + how to test

ACCEPTANCE:
Milestone validation checklist passes.

VERIFICATION:
Commands to run + expected evidence.
badPrompt: Build everything in the plan now.
improvedPrompt: Implement only M01 auth middleware; do not touch UI; no new packages; show test command.
expectedOutput: A small diff with test steps.
